articles.title: Data Center Adjunct Touches Buy Point As Analyst Calls It A Buy
articles.mainIdea: Data Center Adjunct Touches Buy Point As Analyst Calls It A Buy
articles.summary: Investor's Business Daily: Data Center Adjunct Touches Buy Point As Analyst Calls It A Buy. Shares of Primoris Services reached a buy point Tuesday after an analyst upgraded the stock, a play on data center growth. A Guggenheim analyst upgraded the heavy construction company to buy from a neutral rating, according to Dow Jones Newswires. The Guggenheim note placed a 160 price target on the stock, which traded around 137 Tuesday morning. Related tickers mentioned: PRIM.
